title: Integrated Pest Management, Biosecurity, and Sanitation

sourceControl.sourceTitle: THC Cannabis Encyclopedia — Master 420-Entry Content Map v1.1 — Part 17
sourceControl.rule: Preserve permanent THC-ENC IDs and controlled titles; keep prevention, monitoring, identification, thresholds, biosecurity controls, cleaning, disinfection, regulated-product use, and verification as distinct evidence/decision layers; do not convert generic greenhouse guidance into unsupported Cannabis-specific efficacy claims.

educationalBoundary: Plant-health IPM, biosecurity, sanitation, monitoring, and lawful control education only. Pesticide, disinfectant, biopesticide, and other regulated-product use remains governed by current labels, registrations, worker-safety requirements, residue rules, equipment compatibility, and jurisdictional law. No universal Cannabis threshold, quarantine duration, disinfectant recipe, or facility layout is implied where evidence does not support one.
